step_policy: Per dataset common candidate L=max(32*complete infinity norm,1.05*maximum historical atom/probability bound over baseline and three changed OPT rules), capped at the universal probability-floor bound. Set h=.9/L with frozen native parameter formulas. Recompute full targets, native discrete derivatives and OPT. Before any draws require every new rule's exact scanned support bound <=L; otherwise increase L and recompute all changed targets. GDSC universal bound alone is sufficient. No adaptation to formal draws.
probability_policy: Preserve original UNI/NORM/LEV and OPT definitions; no added stability probability constraints.
parameter_policy: Preserve historical c and alpha calibration; recalculate finite iteration counts and RK4 mesh. Retain every prescribed native update and RK4 stage. No eigendecomposition, spectral formula, matrix power, early stopping or trajectory substitution.
parallelism: Independent output-coordinate adjoint blocks and independent sketches only; no change to frozen native numerical kernels.
unchanged_targets: Reuse hash-matched historical Ridge/HBF/SOAR targets, sensitivities and probabilities because those algorithms and their parameters are unchanged. All six methods receive fresh formal subsamples.
reporting: Finite-repetition empirical comparisons plus first-order calibration and explicit support stability certificates; stability alone does not establish finite-budget complete MSE ordering.
